readings: For each archival status (`archstat`) in the QC data, with a missing status treated as its own group, count the QC records. Work out each status's share as that count divided by the sum of the counts over all statuses. Return only the statuses whose share is above the average share across statuses. Show the status, the count, the share, and how far the share is above the average share, with no rounding.
queries:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT archstat AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY archstat
),
shares AS (
  SELECT status, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM counts) AS share
  FROM counts
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_s FROM shares
)
SELECT s.status, s.cnt AS count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_s AS share_above_average
FROM shares s, avg_share a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_s;
